6.97 rsInvalidPreviousAggregateInMatrixCell
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsInvalidPreviousAggregateInMatrixCell is a critical error that will occur when a Previous aggregate
functions is used in an expression within a MatrixCell element.
